issues.detail: reply_matches "IMPLEMENTATION|[Ii]mplementation [Rr]eview" is case-sensitive on the bare identifier. A run that wrote only "review kind: Implementation" would fail, but the protocol requires naming the review kind (identifier IMPLEMENTATION) and any mention of REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION also matches, so a correct run practically always satisfies it.

Settings fields all have defaults (llm_model, database_path) where the catalog listed them without defaults; the generator explains this keeps dataclass field order. Behavior the case relies on (LLM_API_KEY defaults to empty, env overrides .env, loaded once) is intact.
